title: Tude strawberry cream ice cream (2D motion graphic)

review.subject: 2D motion graphic, 'Tude' strawberry-cream ice cream tub. 15.0s, 9:16 frame holding a 16:9 ad with blurred copies of it above and below.
review.summary: 2D motion graphic, 'Tude' strawberry-cream ice cream tub. 15.0s, 9:16 frame holding a 16:9 ad with blurred copies of it above and below.

beats.note: pink plate with one organic blob behind the tub, strawberries and halves orbit and slide round the tub, thin line squiggles draw in; tagline 'WITH LOVE, FROM NATURE.' appears word by word. Very slow pull-out, 3.7%.
a strawberry-cream splash covers the frame and wipes to crimson; the logo animates in with a colour flash (yellow, navy, white); pull-out 28%.
crimson field, logo, 'IT'S IRRESISTIBLE', 'PREMIUM ICE CREAMS'. Static hold 3.7s (25% of the runtime).

learn: Landscape ad in a portrait frame: fill the bands with a blurred, enlarged copy of the same frame.
